title: Ultrasonic Pulse Transmission Tests: Datasets in MATLABv6 format - Test Series 3, Reference Tests on Air
measurement_dates: Original test-series record published July 2023; retained MATLAB export headers dated September 2025.
author_preprocessing: Author conversion from GNU Octave binary v4 into MATLAB v6 files. SciPy may read headers but not all Octave structures; source technical description and reader requirements are retained.
known_analyses_and_limitations: Group complete sensor/condition tests. Native-reader compatibility is separate from authenticated bytes; do not silently convert source files.
independent_groups: sensor types, distances and pulse conditions
